newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Planet Hollywood started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Planet Hollywood started.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it initiated coverage of Planet Hollywood International Inc with a strong buy.
-- Set 12-month price target of $33 a share.
-- Said believes company's strengths "will ultimately result in sustainable high-growth, high octane returns."
-- Believes Planet Hollywood's brands represent the company's most valuable asset.
-- Believes the management team represents the best assembled team of brand manageers in the leisure industry.
-- Belives theme restaurants represent the most profitable "vehicle" within the most profitable sector of the U.S. restaurant industry.
